title: Process cleanup: kill list, root causes, and fixes ready for your yes

owner_note.text: Commit is 70% now (42.7 of 61.2 GB), not the 94% you saw; the part we control is about 8-10 GB. Kill list (nothing killed yet): leftover quick-fix stacks qf-4/6/7/8, worktrees read-aloud-next and monorepo-wt-readme-roles (silent 53-67 h), two s.mjs from 10-22, two stale cloudflared stacks, three orphaned Playwright Chrome roots (7652, 34900, 48088); about 24 node + 8 chrome, saves 1.5-2 GB. Keep: sustain/Servex/gate, main site, qf-1, the live tunnel; recite python and whisper-server are idle-but-reusable, so unload them on idle, not kill. Root causes: (1) Lifecycle.kept() exempts any worktrees/qf-N path, but only qf-1 is in the pool; (2) the live reaper hasn't logged a close since 11-02 though its dry run says it would close two (needs one live dry sweep to settle); (3) worktree-down retries merge-staged every ~4 min forever; (4) no idle timeout; (5) hand-started jobs have no owner record; (6) no close-out step. The Code.exe doubling is real (~2.5 GB for one minute, working set, not commit), not a monitor artifact. Priority: narrow kept() + settle the sweep, back off the retry loop, log each sweep + gate spawns on commit % (80/90), idle timeouts, close-out rule in the mastermind role. Say yes and I build 1-3 in a worktree.
